# OPSCI.ca — Ontario Public Sector Compensation Insights

> OPSCI is an independent analysis site built on Ontario's public-sector salary disclosures (the "Sunshine List"), covering {{ site_years[0] }}–{{ site_years[1] }}. It links employee records across years, groups similar job titles, and compares pay across employers, jobs, sectors and years. A project of kdsay labs inc.

Key facts for interpreting the data:

- The disclosure covers employees paid $100,000 or more in salary in a calendar year. It is not a complete workforce list, and the threshold has never been indexed to inflation.
- "Disclosed employees" and "total disclosed salary" refer only to people on the list; total disclosed salary is salary only, excluding taxable benefits.
- Matching employees across years is an estimate: records may occasionally be joined or split incorrectly.
- Raise figures are same-person comparisons (same job group in consecutive years; employer-level figures also require the same employer), not differences between group averages.
- Appearing on the list for the first time does not necessarily mean a new hire; disappearing does not necessarily mean someone left.
- Gender figures are name-based estimates shown only for groups, never for individuals.

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ url_for('home.index', _external=True) }}): province-wide trend, sector mix, largest employers, top roles
- [Positions]({{ url_for('position.search', _external=True) }}): normalized job titles by sector, with pay by employer and region and where people in each role came from
- [Employers]({{ url_for('employer.search', _external=True) }}): every employer on the list, with sector overviews
- [Top Earners]({{ url_for('top_earners.index', _external=True) }}): highest disclosed salaries by year, sector and position
- [Regional Differences]({{ url_for('regions.index', _external=True) }}): location premiums by region, jobs paid the same everywhere, and regional pay gaps over ten years
- [Metro Areas]({{ url_for('metro.index', _external=True) }}): Ontario's 12 largest municipal areas, each with all of its municipal employers; benchmark jobs and leadership pay compared across them
- [Inflation]({{ url_for('inflation.index', _external=True) }}): the list with the 1996 $100,000 threshold indexed to Ontario CPI, by year and by sector, and whether the most common jobs have kept up with prices
- [Employees]({{ url_for('employee.search', _external=True) }}): search for individuals on the list
